inputs.name: Search application logs by symptom
inputs.description: Find the log lines behind a reported symptom without knowing the service that wrote them.
inputs.problem: On-call engineers know the symptom, not the service, and lose time guessing which log index to open.

inputs.name: Summarize an incident timeline
inputs.description: Turn alerts, chat and deploy events into one ordered account of what happened.

inputs.name: Triage incoming alerts at volume
inputs.description: Sort a stream of alerts into pages, tickets and noise against the team's runbook.
inputs.problem: Alert volume outgrows the on-call rotation, so real pages are found late among duplicates.

inputs.name: Write and update runbooks
inputs.description: Draft a runbook from past incidents and keep it current as the service changes.
inputs.problem: Runbooks go stale because writing one is a separate task from fixing the incident.

inputs.name: Assist code review
inputs.description: Point a reviewer at the risky parts of a change and the tests that do not cover them.
inputs.problem: Reviewers skim large diffs and miss the few lines that carry the risk.

inputs.name: Draft release notes
inputs.description: Write release notes from merged changes, grouped by what a user sees.

inputs.name: Generate test cases for a change
inputs.description: Propose unit and edge-case tests for a changed function.

inputs.name: Explain unfamiliar code
inputs.description: Describe what a module does and what depends on it.

inputs.name: Document datasets and columns
inputs.description: Keep dataset and column descriptions current, with owners and freshness.
inputs.problem: Most tables have no description, so analysts ask in chat which column to trust.

inputs.name: Find internal engineering documentation
inputs.description: Answer a question from the organization's own design notes and wikis.
inputs.problem: The answer exists in a wiki page that nobody can find by title.

inputs.name: Look up public documentation
inputs.description: Find and read vendor and open-source documentation for a library or service.
inputs.problem: Engineers paste snippets from search results without checking the version they apply to.

inputs.name: Search model gateway traces
inputs.description: Find model calls by the words in a prompt or reply, then see whose session and which workflow.

inputs.name: Watch service level objective burn
inputs.description: Warn when an error budget is being spent faster than planned.

inputs.name: Correlate deploys with error spikes
inputs.description: Show which release preceded a change in error rate.

inputs.name: Detect unusual log patterns
inputs.description: Surface log patterns that have not been seen before in a service.

inputs.name: Explain a slow request
inputs.description: Walk a request's trace and say where the time went.

inputs.name: Review access requests
inputs.description: Check a request for access against role and recent use.

inputs.name: Scan dependencies for known issues
inputs.description: List vulnerable dependencies and the services that ship them.

inputs.name: Review infrastructure changes
inputs.description: Flag infrastructure changes that open ports or widen permissions.

inputs.name: Classify data sensitivity
inputs.description: Label columns that hold personal or confidential values.

inputs.name: Trace data lineage
inputs.description: Show where a column comes from and what reads it.

inputs.name: Answer questions from the warehouse
inputs.description: Turn a plain question into a checked query and an explained result.

inputs.name: Monitor data quality
inputs.description: Notice late, empty or out-of-range loads before a report does.

inputs.name: Estimate cloud cost of a change
inputs.description: Predict the monthly cost of a proposed deployment.

inputs.name: Plan capacity
inputs.description: Project load and say when a service needs more room.

inputs.name: Schedule on-call rotations
inputs.description: Build a fair rotation from availability and time zones.

inputs.name: Onboard new engineers
inputs.description: Give a new engineer a reading order and a first task.

inputs.name: Keep documentation in sync with code
inputs.description: Find documentation that a code change has made wrong.

inputs.name: Translate documentation
inputs.description: Produce and review translations of user-facing documentation.

inputs.name: Review pull request descriptions
inputs.description: Check that a description says what changed, why and how it was tested.

inputs.name: Lumen Search
inputs.summary: Search over application logs and traces with natural-language queries.
inputs.caveat: Does not index archived log files older than the retention window.

inputs.name: Beacon Triage
inputs.summary: Groups and ranks alerts and proposes a response from the runbook.

inputs.name: Pylon Alerts
inputs.summary: Alert routing with duplicate suppression.
inputs.caveat: Available to teams on the shared paging plan only.

inputs.name: Quill Review
inputs.summary: Reviews changes for risky patterns and missing tests.
inputs.caveat: Evaluation uses a copy of the repositories, not the live ones.

inputs.name: Strata Catalog
inputs.summary: Dataset descriptions, owners and lineage.

inputs.name: Tessera Docs
inputs.summary: Search and question answering over internal documentation.
inputs.caveat: Wiki spaces marked restricted are not indexed.

inputs.name: Ferrite Assist
inputs.summary: An assistant for writing and explaining code in the editor.

inputs.name: Kestrel Logs
inputs.summary: Keyword and field search over structured logs.

inputs.name: Meridian Runbooks
inputs.summary: Runbook authoring with version history.
inputs.caveat: Contract not signed; do not onboard teams yet.

inputs.name: Orbit Notebook
inputs.summary: Shared notebooks with scheduled runs.

inputs.name: Sable Lineage
inputs.summary: Column-level lineage across warehouse jobs.
inputs.caveat: Withdrawn from the evaluation; no plan to reinstate.

inputs.name: Tandem Review
inputs.summary: Pairs a reviewer with suggested checks per change.

inputs.notes: Anomalies are per service, not across services.

inputs.name: Alert triage against runbook
inputs.summary: Compare an incoming alert with the team's runbook and say whether it needs a page, a ticket or neither.

inputs.name: Datamap
inputs.summary: The organization's own app for describing datasets and their owners. It opens as an app of its own.

inputs.name: Dataset description review
inputs.summary: Check draft dataset and column descriptions against the documentation standard before they are published.

inputs.name: Documentation search
inputs.summary: Find earlier design notes similar to a described problem.

inputs.name: Log query
inputs.summary: Ask a question about the logs of one service and get an answer grounded in the matching lines.

inputs.name: Runbook drafting with Lumen Search
inputs.summary: Demonstration entry. Gives the user a ready runbook drafting prompt to run in Lumen Search.
inputs.prompt: Draft a first-pass runbook from the attached incident review, keeping our standard sections, and list every step you added.

inputs.name: Run this prompt with Lumen Search
inputs.summary: Gives the user a ready prompt and sends them to Lumen Search to run it.
inputs.prompt: Review the attached alert export against our standard severities for paging, ticketing and suppression. List each alert that departs from them and suggest the correct handling.

inputs.name: Public research
inputs.summary: Look up public information on the web and read the pages: published documentation, release notes and general technical background.

inputs.name: Trace search
inputs.summary: Search the model gateway's traces and inference tables by keyword with read-only SQL: find calls by the words in a prompt or reply, then see whose session and which workflow.

inputs.statement: Lumen v1 finds the log lines behind a symptom accurately, at 0.94 across 40 sample incidents on error, service and time window, but misses lines in rotated archive files when the archive is appended after the live file.
